capture.intro: Describe it in your own words. Submit saves it and keeps brainstorming with you in chat. Save keeps it for later and starts nothing else.

actions.label: Submit
actions.meaning: Existing: save, then continue brainstorming in chat.

actions.label: Save
actions.meaning: Existing: save for later without further discussion, definition, or execution.

actions.label: Cancel
actions.meaning: Existing: no runtime call; return to Needs you and keep the draft in this tab.

capture.footnote: Cancel keeps your draft in this tab and returns to Needs you. It doesn't undo anything already sent. Reloading the page clears the draft.

validation.empty: Describe the work before submitting or saving.
validation.tooLong: This is too long to send. Shorten it and try again. Nothing was cut or sent.

statuses.rule: One polite live status region; [title, body]. Show no classification in any status.
sending: Sending this to Dude. Don't submit it again.
awaitingSave: Waiting for Dude to save it
Dude has your text and is saving it. Nothing is confirmed yet, and your draft stays here.
uncertain: Canvas couldn't confirm delivery, so it won't send this again. Check the chat; if Dude saves it, this changes to Saved. Your draft stays here.
savedSubmit: Saved as work item {number}. Dude will keep brainstorming it with you in chat.
savedSave: Saved as work item {number} for later. Nothing else was started.
statuses.savedDetail: After the body, show any owner note exactly as received, then the saved path as quiet code text, as today. {number} is the number in the saved file name.
notSent: Dude became busy before this could be sent, so nothing was sent or saved. Try again when Dude is free. Your draft stays here.

cannotSendNow.rule: While Submit and Save are disabled, show one notice for the first condition that applies, in this order. Both disabled buttons name it with aria-describedby. The conditions are today's; only the words change.
notConnected: Canvas can't reach your Dude chat session, so it can't send this now. Your draft is kept. You can also describe the work in chat.
importInProgress: An import from Add/import isn't finished yet. Submit and Save turn back on when it is. Your draft is kept.
pendingQuestion: Finish the pending question in Needs you before submitting. Your draft is kept.
earlierCaptureUnconfirmed: Your last capture isn't confirmed yet
Submit and Save turn back on once Dude confirms it. If nothing changes, check the chat. Your draft is kept.
busy: Submit and Save turn back on when Dude finishes what it's doing in chat. Your draft is kept.

notice: Dude saves this text as a work item for later. It doesn't answer this question or give permission for anything.
saveAsWorkItem.statuses: The capture statuses above, using savedSave when saved.

classificationDisplay.format: Intent word, then domain word, joined by ' · '. One word when only one value is recorded. Nothing when neither is recorded or a value is unrecognized. Accessible text joins with ', '.
classificationDisplay.list: Quiet secondary line under the title in the Name cell, only when there are words. No new column, filter, or sort.
classificationDisplay.details: Header: eyebrow 'Work item', number and title, the stage, and a quiet line of words only when there are words. No labeled Intent, Domain, or Stage list and no correction instruction.
classificationDisplay.rowAccessibleName: {number}. {title}. {words joined by ', ', when any}. Stage: {stage}{, note}. {progress}. {ideaPath}
neverShow: any instruction to set, confirm, or correct a classification
warning or error styling for a missing or unknown classification
classificationDisplay.unreadableRecord: 912 keeps today's unavailable stage and progress and says nothing about classification.

fixtures.meaning: Classification on fixtures 901 to 913 stands for what Dude recorded during capture or brainstorm. Nobody chose it in Canvas.
changes: 911: change the domain from other to unrecorded.
909: keep its unrecognized intent to show that it is hidden.
Repository snapshot: no record holds a classification, so no repository row or details view shows classification words.

clear.text: The export button is hidden on small screens.
clear.afterSave: Row 914 shows the words Fix · Code and the stage Captured.

vague.afterSave: Row 914 shows no classification line and the stage Captured.

existing.text: Uploads still stall on slow connections.
existing.ownerNote: Matched the existing work item 901 Retry failed uploads.
